proposal.brief_basis: The task requires reviewing the temperature record, and the visible dashboard link is the ordinary navigation to that record.
The dashboard is the visible evidence source, and the workflow form must be opened to review its available routing choices and required fields.

chart_1 shows temperature falling from 23.9°C in 2005 to 10.1°C in 2014 (a 13.8°C period-wide decrease), but no active public rule or threshold defines when that change is large enough for targeted follow-up versus routine monitoring.
